verdict.rationale: Secureframe claims broad integration coverage ("100+ integrations," "hundreds of tools") spanning categories implied by its features (ticketing via Jira/Slack, ticketing sync for access reviews), but the evidence pack lacks a documented integrations catalog listing specific connectors for cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, and MDM, and never mentions read-only scopes or permission models for these integrations. Missing for 10: an actual integrations catalog page enumerating providers by category, and explicit documentation of read-only/least-privilege scopes for each connection.
